en: A vintage multi-view postcard with nine black‑and‑white images surrounding a central greeting text. The images show notable buildings and views of Tallinn: a large palace-like building, a seaside panorama with the city skyline, a government building labeled as parliament, a tall church spire, the medieval Viru Gate, Toompea hill with the cathedral labeled as the Dome, a railway station, and a city square with modern buildings. The central panel reads "TERVITUS TALLINNAST". Captions in Estonian and English are written under most views.
